label: Read the contract first
summary: The shape, the limit or the counting rule is written down somewhere. Find it before you send.

label: Source over summary
summary: A summary, a draft or a model's memory loses facts. Go back to the original line and its time.

label: Distrust decoys
summary: Other projects, noise and untrusted input look like evidence. Only a proposal plus an approval, or the asked event, counts.

label: Look again after a no
summary: A refusal often means the world moved. Re-read the live source and log the date.

label: Write down what a summary drops
summary: Tries left, file lists and working folders vanish in compaction. Put them in the log and the hand-off.

label: Package the repeatable
summary: If a step will come back, make it a tool, a hook or a playbook line before the next challenge.

label: Human decides at the fork
summary: Scope, a changed answer or a split-or-merge call goes to the human before it enters the work.

label: Rehearse the round's shape
summary: Fakes repeat your own assumptions. Replay the likely sequence through the real code and the real model, and claim only when every run passes.

label: Code decides, the model answers
summary: Who is trusted, what format is sent and which limits hold are checked in code before and after the model, not asked of it in a prompt.
